name: Socket (Bungee)

classification.summary: SocketGateway: the swap route registered 3 days earlier (routeId 406 -> 0xCC5fDA5e3cA925bd0bb428C8b2669496eE43067e) performed an unvalidated user-controlled call, draining approvals. Route installation emits NewRouteAdded(uint32,address), not an EIP-1967 Upgraded event.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/socket.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.

sources.note: onchain review (RPC only): SocketGateway 0x3a23F943181408EAC424116Af7b7790c94Cb97a5 created 2023-03-17T15:04:59Z at block 16848303; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded logs over [16848303, 19019307]. Code is installed as routes and controllers, so all 8 topics the gateway emits in the window were enumerated: the change channels are NewRouteAdded(uint32,address) 0x7977983873e5c968018b0deaedba28f6ce6253277670e94e627fbc08efc50cb1 (22 events, routeIds 0x181-0x196) and ControllerAdded(uint32,address) 0x7601ed90c4c6f485f9633a9355c473c63ec60dfb8e04d060dbda9a80cf48eb68 (3 events: 2023-04-05, 2023-06-27, 2023-07-31); RouteDisabled (0xc60cf0bdf6c913c2d080d151c29909503abb49cdd09b459a7a10a16a466d02da) and ControllerDisabled never fired, and the remaining topics are OwnerNominated/OwnerClaimed and high-volume bridge events. The last route installed before the incident is routeId 406 -> 0xCC5fDA5e3cA925bd0bb428C8b2669496eE43067e at block 18996162, 2024-01-13T06:23:47Z, tx 0x1df44e224c7a715da25fa33dcad2ca3a930d1a4dafd263e61c07b52673d505f4 - exactly the route the exploit (tx 0xc6c3331fa8c2d30e1ef208424c08c039a89e510df2fb6ae31e5aa40722e28fd6, 2024-01-16T19:11:23Z) invoked through executeRoute(406, ...). The previously recorded day-level date 2024-01-12 is one day early; age 345600s -> 279373s. The registry row socketgateway.json measures the same change against the exact exploit-tx timestamp 1705432283 and therefore reports 305256s.

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/socket.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
